controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS Voyager/Galileo mosaic on a 1 km grid; original detail varies from about 1 to 10 km per pixel. Gray grid marks documented no-data and its resampled boundary. Photographed terrain shading remains; globe lighting is approximate.
controls.summary: Voyager and Galileo images with detail from 1 to 10 km per pixel. Shadows remain; gray grid: no source imagery.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: USGS enhanced-color mosaic: near-infrared, green and violet color ratios combined with observed monochrome detail. USGS corrected broad limb darkening and matched image seams. Source color detail varies from 1.3 to 21 km per pixel. Interpolated polar color is withheld; observed monochrome remains where available. Gray grid marks missing imagery. Acquisition shading, seams and changes between mission dates can remain; globe lighting is approximate.
controls.summary: Infrared, green and violet ratios with monochrome detail. Interpolated polar color is withheld.

controls.label: Geology
controls.description: Fourteen base geologic units mapped from Voyager and Galileo observations. Colors distinguish interpreted plains, lava flows, patera floors and mountains. The separate diffuse-deposit overlay and structural linework are not shown. Gray grid marks unmapped or conflicting polygons; this view adds no measured relief.

legend.title: Geologic units
legend.meta: Symbols identify archived categories. Colors are chosen for this display.
